description: Searches ordered; client to send ID; fee earner to chase. One explicit date.

segments.text: Hello, it's Sarah Whitfield. I wanted to ask how the searches are going on Meadow Road.
Hello Sarah. We ordered the local authority search and the drainage and water search on Monday. The results should be back by Friday the 16th of October.
Okay. Is there anything you need from me?
Yes, we still need your photo ID and proof of address. Could you send those over by tomorrow?
Thank you. I'll chase the search provider on Wednesday if we've not heard anything.
